operations.title: Entry 1233 — The Primary Source Defines a Five-Site Period but No Finite Period Block
operations.path: src/ledger/20260820-1233 The Primary Source Defines a Five-Site Period but No Finite Period Block.md
operations.body: Benincasa–Vazao arXiv:2402.06558v3 defines the general Cayley-Menger loop integral and contour, with explicit examples only through three sites; it supplies no five-site finite master/PF/GM block. The canonical next object is the scalar physical period Pi_C5 formed from that contour and the frozen 180-term OFPT function, and its cyclic D-module D·Pi_C5.

operations.title: Benincasa freezes the canonical five-site integrated coefficient target
operations.body: Entry 1233 audits the primary source: it defines the general physical loop period and CM contour but no five-site finite master/PF/GM block. I therefore froze the canonical scalar Pi_C5 using our 180-term OFPT packet and d=3 current, with coefficient target the cyclic D-module D·Pi_C5. Next is a predeclared cyclic physical one-parameter slice and a certified scalar annihilator search; no finite master basis will be selected by convenience.

authority_basis.summary: Record the five-site primary-source period gate and notify marici.Nima.
